summary: This note covers the principal photography schedule for the 2016 film The Choice, shot in and around Wilmington, North Carolina. Filming ran from October 13 to November 21, 2014, at several locations near Wrightsville Beach before moving to a house in downtown Wilmington.
one_line: Production details of the 2016 film The Choice, including its October–November 2014 shoot in Wilmington, North Carolina.
key_facts: Principal photography on The Choice (2016 film) began on October 13, 2014, in Wilmington, North Carolina.
Principal photography on The Choice lasted through November 21, 2014.
For the first three days of filming, the crew and extras filmed at the Dockside Restaurant & Bar and Bridge Tender Marina along with actors.
The first three days of filming took place near Wrightsville Beach.
On October 20, 2014, filming took place at Hanover Seaside Club in Wrightsville Beach.
The production of The Choice later moved to downtown Wilmington, North Carolina.
In downtown Wilmington, filming for The Choice took place in a house.
